dial_tui_operation: Five render states (UI-SPEC Section 7 / dial-presenter.cjs): S1 (mode_a clear leader: 1 filled ▶ on reach #1; rows 2-3 get ▷; footer stat-strip), S2 (mode_a near-tie: 2 filled ▶ on reach #1 + #2 when margin < 0.15; row 3 gets ▷), S3 (mode_b: all ▷; framing 'No recommendation - offline. You pick.'; honest low %), S4 (tier_0 cold-room: all ▷; framing 'New room - nothing to rank yet. Start anywhere.'; confidence '--'), S5 (partial-slot degradation: markers per gate; unresolvable {topic} slot drops to generic JTBD one_line label; marker logic unchanged).

Resting-detent commit (implicit sync): navigator commits without rotating -> writeEdge SELECTED_REACH FROM active focus TO cmd:<command> with props {jtbd, framework, recommended, decision_id} + logMemoryEvent f_selector_sync_confirmed (the resting detent IS the in-sync signal, DIALTUI-07).

Rotate-to-pivot commit (explicit disagreement): navigator commits OFF the recommended reach -> writeEdge PIVOTED FROM chosen TO declined-recommended with ENUM-ONLY props {declined_recommended:cmd:..., margin, decision_id} + logMemoryEvent f_selector_pivot + investment-scaled pivot_penalty decay back into the ranker + ALSO writeEdge SELECTED_REACH to the chosen (not-recommended) reach.
Defer / Reject: delegate to selector-decisions.recordSelectorDecision (DEFERRED +30d or REJECTED cascade edge). NO SELECTED_REACH (not a committed reach). NO next-action.

Free-Text / none-fit overflow: delegate to selector-decisions.recordSelectorMiss({top_k_offered, user_intent}). NO cascade edge, NO SELECTED_REACH. The host-injected 'Type something' / 'Chat about this' rows handle overflow; NEVER add a 4th explicit Free-Text row (AP5).

Confidence column dial: right-aligned monospace NN% (or '--' in tier_0). Scanning the right column top-to-bottom IS reading the dial. The filled/empty triangle glyph prefix (▶ / ▷) is the visual hierarchy + the RECOMMENDED marker. In Mode B / Tier 0, all rows get ▷ (zero filled markers) and this absence reads as INTENTIONAL, not broken.

Recommended gate (frozen, Part 3 frozen floor 0.70 / 0.15 margin): reach#1.recommended = (tier_mode=='mode_a') AND (reach#1.score >= 0.70); reach#2.recommended = (tier_mode=='mode_a') AND (reach#2.score >= 0.70) AND ((reach#1.score - reach#2.score) < 0.15); all others = false. In Mode B / Tier 0, recommended = always false (zero markers).
